items.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 29 at 3:38PM AKDT until October 30 at 4:15PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Small stream and localized urban flooding caused by
excessive rainfall is possible.


* WHERE...Seward.

* WHEN...Until 415 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rainfall may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Storm drains and ditches may become clogged with debris. Flooding
may occur in poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Light rainfall will gradually increase in intensity this evening
and continue through Friday m
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 29 at 2:49PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Snowfall is expected through Atigun Pass beginning Friday morning
through Saturday night. 4 to 8 inches are expected during this
time and may make travel difficult. Wind gusts up to 25 mph may
reduce visibility to below a half mile at times.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 29 at 2:45PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Heavy snow is expected along the Dalton Highway through Saturday
morning. Total snow accumulations could range between 5 and 10
inches during this time frame. Travel could become difficult
during periods of heavier snowfall.
items.areas: South Slopes Of The Central Brooks Range

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 29 at 2:43PM AKDT until October 30 at 5:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 45 mph with gusts up to 75 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are likely late Thursday
night into Friday morning.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 29 at 2:41PM AKDT until October 31 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8
inches. Winds gusting as high as 30 mph.

* WHERE...Southern Denali Borough.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT Friday Night.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest amounts expected between mile marker
215 and 225 along the Parks Highway.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 29 at 2:35PM AKDT until October 31 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2.5 to 3.5 feet above the normal high
tide expected during the Thursday and Friday high tides.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast, specifically Hooper Bay.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Beach property and lowest buildings may be impacted.
Multiple high tide cycles above normal may lead to localized
beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels of around 1 to 3 feet above
the normal high tide line are expected along the rest of the
Yukon Delta Coast.
items.instruction:
See weather.gov/afg for the latest updates. Take the necessary
actions to protect flood-prone property.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 29 at 1:34PM AKDT until October 30 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 40 to 55 mph with gusts up to 75 mph.

* WHERE...Atka and Adak.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong winds out of the west-southwest. Wind
gusts may diminish this evening into tonight. A second round of
strong northwesterly wind gusts is expected late tonight through
Friday afternoon before finally diminishing.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of widespread
power outages.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 29 at 1:34PM AKDT until October 31 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 30 to 45 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Unalaska and Nikolski.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Friday to 10 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Southwest will increase tonight with gusts up
to 40 to 50 mph. Winds diminish Friday morning before a stronger
round of northwest winds develop by Friday afternoon.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

A Winter Storm Warning for snow means severe winter weather
conditions will make travel very hazardous. If you must travel, keep
an extra flashlight, food and water in your vehicle in case of an
emergency.

For the latest road conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.description:
